title: Hierarchical Low-Rank Reparameterization for Parameter-Efficient
abstract: arXiv:2610.37068v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. translated_title: 用于参数高效微调的分层低秩重参数化方法
translated_abstract: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法通过引入少量可训练参数来适配大型模型。然而，我们发现这些参数仍然存在冗余，可以在保持强大任务性能的同时进一步压缩。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的分层低秩重参数化方法。其核心思想是将PEFT方法的可训练参数重组为一个近似方阵，然后通过低秩分解来表示它，并且这一过程可以递归应用。这形成了一个多层次结构，其分解因子逐层压缩，从而大幅减少可训练参数的数量。在实验中，我们将这种重参数化方法与LoRA、DoRA、MoSA和RaSA相结合。我们在LLaMA-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上评估了常识推理能力，并在LLaMA-3.1-8B上进行了额外的GSM8K数学推理实验。在相当的可训练参数预算下，我们的方法与这些方法结合后表现出……
tldr: 提出了一种可递归应用的分层低秩重参数化方法，将PEFT方法的可训练参数逐层压缩，在保持任务性能的同时大幅减少可训练参数数量。
en_tdlr: Proposes a recursively applicable hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method that compresses the trainable parameters of PEFT methods level by level, drastically reducing trainable parameters while maintaining strong task performance.
